title: PackageSequencingState
description: Authoritative execution cursor, frozen attempt tree and revision.

id.description: Immutable identity allocated once by the interoperability owner.

registration_id.description: Single current instance of edition sequencing for the package attempt.
registration_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve inside the owning Institution or the directly owned aggregate.

organization_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve inside the owning Institution or the directly owned aggregate.

current_occurrence_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve inside the owning Institution or the directly owned aggregate.

suspended_occurrence_id.description: Resume cursor for a suspended activity.
suspended_occurrence_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve inside the owning Institution or the directly owned aggregate.

active_path.description: Ordered activity IDs from root through current active path.
active_path.x-reference-scope: Each occurrence lies in this state's organization tree.

delivery_pending.description: Whether a selected resource still awaits authorized launch.

ended.description: Whether this sequencing session has ended.

sequence_revision.description: Monotonic aggregate revision used for compare-and-swap.

updated_at.description: Server time of last sequencing transaction.

x-invariants: Current and suspended pointers must be in the same immutable activity tree.
The active path has no gaps or cycles and frozen per-attempt child lists live on activity attempts.
